book.name: 2 Korin
book.title: 2 Korin Pol re Korin kwomri tatame remne peswe basrasem siglow.

content: An kemne sene lasyate wem, kem pap yaper kap tete, eker an wuribaike habom, an be yate.
An keremkene gwule tete, kem pap yaper tete. Etop tete, yike anne ari pap heyar nenen an okbop tete? Keremwou kem ari pap pulten an pap kwuye sene mette.

Keremkene an okbop tete selbo, opkap an kemne be lasyan an pap yaper be tem. Eker an siglow kiyi basrasen kemne newopitim. An op wem. Kem gwule kiyi kelmenate, yuri an kemne lasyate, an pap yaper be tete. Yaper nenem tame rem gwule kelmenate, an remne metekwaste. An op sanetene. An okbop tete, kerem mere, kem okbop kirkir tete.
Kiyi an kemne er siglow basrasem, an pap yaper kenakem meten kirabem. Kerem pap yaper tete, an etop be basrasem. Kem sanete, an kemne pap yowen kwobo labo, etopkap an siglow eker basrasem.
Tame wuri re yaper wos nenem, Korin tame rem rekene kelmenate.
Tame wuri re yaper wos nenem, kem pap yaper tem. An bo. An rene kwobke wete muwebo, eker et tuma an sou be wete.
Kem rene yaper sein nenemkap, et yow.
Er tame re pap yaperwai kap ten Haneyen reri wule kap mesegente. Opkap, kem rene agerbo wule nente. Kem rekene kelmenan let kerete. Kem rene yenbo nente, re pap kwuye sene mette.
An kemne omuteke webo. Kem rene pap sene yewote. Kem rene etop heyar peterate.
An kemne kiyi siglow basrasen newopitim, an kemne seilam, kem ari tuma heyar meten etop nenbo, o kem be nenbo? An kemne etop seilam.
Kem tatame remne kelmenan let kerete, an etop mette, aren mere, an remkene let kerete. An remne tuma sene be wete. An gwule kelmenate wete, an kemne habon Krais eterri bitimik an etop nenbo.
Berke an etop nenbo? Satan re nemne kap teitkwunte. Reri nemne yaper nenbo habobokap nem sanetene. Eker nem gwule kelmenate. Nem etop nente, Satan re nemne mapurke teitkwunte.
Pol re Taitus rene late wem.
Kiyi an Troas kwomke yim, Krais eterri Tuma Yenbo an er kwomri tatame remne wesowte yim. Haneyen re anne kwobo lam, an yaku etek kebese nenem.
Ari mase, Taitus, re Troas be yamenem, an pap yaper meten habolaweyem. An Troas tatame remne pir wen mesegenen Masedonia yokwok yim, Taitus rene sopen yim.
God eterri kitimenak Jisas reri werasem yi tame rem Haneyen eterri peiktame remne teitkwunbem.

An God rene wese abo. Kwokwos kwokwos re Krais eterke nemne kwobo labo. Nem wule yaper eterke teitkwunbo. Re nemne wem, nem kwomke kwomke yin Jisas Krais rene remne wesowen sewurbo. Op nenbo, et bos yenbo kwomke kwomke metbokap.
Krais re neremri wuribaike tetane, et Krais re God rene bos yenbo aseneke newobokap. Hevenke yibo tatamekene ker kwomke yibo tatamekene rem er bos kirkir metbo.

Ker kwomke yibo tatame rem er bos metbo, rem kupa beles rik metbo. Rem sanebo, rem sate tetane. Hevenke yibo tatame rem er bos metbo, rem metekwasbo. Rem sanebo, rem heyar somsom temente tetane. Yike er yaku kebese nente.

Nugwape tame rem God Reri Tuma wesowbo, rem kel potte etopwou habobo. Nem opkap bo. God eter, re nemne er yaku nente wem, nem eterri tuma omuteke wesowbo. Nem Krais eteri yaku nen tame. God re labo, nem eterri tuma heyar wesowbo.
